_comment: Demonstrates the `video` scene. Put a demo MP4 (+ optional <name>.mp4.chapters.json sidecar) at examples/demos/your-demo.mp4 — e.g. copy a kitsoki .artifacts/<feature>/<feature>-demo.mp4, or capture one with `slidey capture examples/demos/kitsoki-onboarding-tour.json examples/demos/your-demo.mp4`. Then: slidey examples/demo-video.json out.mp4. PNG/PDF export shows poster frames.
